ORIGINAL USMLE-STYLE PRACTICE

Asthma maintenance treatment: 4

An adult reports persistent asthma symptoms despite a prescribed controller inhaler. During review, the patient cannot demonstrate correct inhalation and frequently misses doses. What should be addressed before automatically escalating the prescribed controller intensity?

  1. Low-dose ICS-formoterol reliever in the preferred adult Track 1 pathway
  2. The same suitable ICS-formoterol inhaler for maintenance and relief
  3. An individualized written asthma action plan
  4. Check diagnosis, inhaler technique, adherence and exposures before stepping up
  5. An inhaled corticosteroid-containing regimen
Answer and explanation

Check diagnosis, inhaler technique, adherence and exposures before stepping up

Correctable delivery and adherence problems may explain poor control without requiring an automatic dose increase.

Option explanations

Check diagnosis, inhaler technique, adherence and exposures before stepping up: Correctable delivery and adherence problems may explain poor control without requiring an automatic dose increase.

An inhaled corticosteroid-containing regimen: Anti-inflammatory treatment reduces exacerbation risk; SABA-only treatment is not recommended for adults with asthma. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.

Low-dose ICS-formoterol reliever in the preferred adult Track 1 pathway: GINA Track 1 uses an anti-inflammatory reliever; the maintenance component depends on the treatment step. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.

The same suitable ICS-formoterol inhaler for maintenance and relief: MART combines scheduled maintenance with as-needed doses of a suitable ICS-formoterol product; it does not apply to every ICS-LABA inhaler. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.

An individualized written asthma action plan: A written plan explains usual treatment, recognition of deterioration, agreed medication changes and when to seek urgent help. This does not best answer the specific question in this case.
